scope: slice 4: Transition authoring and the Zone Layout lane on the ordinary v2 editor route
invariants: A Cut is the absence of a Transition at exact adjacency; the surface selects a derived junction by the view model's own identity and persists no Cut. A key naming no exact adjacency refuses.
Insert offers only derived Cut junctions: a whole-output Transition from conversion is editable by identity and is never created on this route.

A duration change reaches the resize owner, which applies its delta once to the incoming and downstream affected set; a settings or parameter edit moves no Clip and keeps identity, endpoints and window.

Every mutation is one explicit intent planned by a pure editor model and submitted through the closed prepared-edit admission; the panel writes no record and allocates identity only through the caller's generator.
A refusal returns the original record identity with empty affected collections, no history entry and no provider write; the owner's own message reaches the author verbatim, RL08 to RL10 included.

The Zone Layout lane edits only occurrence coverage, routing parameters and the incoming transfer; Clips, Markers, Property tracks and Pattern instances stay exact unless the owner reports them affected.
Identity is never allocated inside a pure owner: a duplicate names one fresh id per identity the owner enumerates, and a blank, duplicate or already-owned id refuses before the owner sees it.
partitions: boundary Layer: Main Layer, overlay Layer, second Zone under a split Layout
Transition kind: crossfade, fade-color, wipe, dither, portal, motion
crossfade policy: live-live and snapshot-live, through Insert and through a settings edit
topology: single boundary, converging chain of two Transitions, boundary coincident with a Layout switch
Transition ramps: none and a global scalar carrier projected on Reset
Layout operation: select-layout, move, make-unique, duplicate (content and empty), remove, set-parameters, set-transfer set and clear
Layout definition: shared by two occurrences and sole, split-capable and single-surface
refusal: RL08 compiler restriction, owned split-position track out of bounds, meaningful transfer on removal, Show End protection, boundary-crossing content duplicate, malformed intent at admission
route: desktop 1440 and narrow 390, Fast and Precise Stage capture, page reload
sequences: select derived Cut -> Insert refused (RL08) -> Insert crossfade -> change kind -> resize -> Undo -> Redo -> Reset to Cut
select occurrence -> Make Layout Unique -> assign another definition -> move switch -> duplicate -> Undo -> set transfer -> clear transfer -> remove -> Undo
insert -> resize -> Reset to Cut -> reopen the exported .epe in Fast and in Precise
moved switch crossing an owned split-position track -> refusal -> record identity unchanged
oracles: The planned intent the closed admission would submit, compared with the pilot editor model's intent for the same parameters.
The record the landed owner returns: exact Clip start times, Transition identity/kind/duration/participants, Layout coverage, transfer and definition rows.
The real store and closed admission through the panel: provider write count, one history entry per adopted edit, and the adopted record.
The reopened .epe through its importer, replayed with createFastReplayRuntime in fast and fidelity at named times; a Reset restores the original frames exactly.
The authenticated route: persisted bytes read back from the provider after each visible action, Fast and Precise Stage captures, reload, 390 px bounds and zero console errors.
Committed browser proof of the route at the candidate commit.
